name: feathersjs-mcp-server

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search the FeathersJS documentation using BGE-M3 dense semantic search. Returns the most relevant documentation chunks for a given query, optionally filtered by version (v5, v6, both, all) and capped by a token budget.

query.description: The search query — a natural language question or keyword phrase.

version.description: FeathersJS version to search (default: all). Use "all" or "both" to search across all versions.

tokensBudget.description: Optional. Trim the result list so the cumulative chunk token count does not exceed this value. Useful for filling a fixed context window.

tools.name: submit_documentation
tools.description: Submit a documentation update or new doc as a GitHub Pull Request for admin review. Content is validated locally (schema, path, sanitization, markdown lint, duplication check) then a PR is automatically created. If GITHUB_TOKEN is not set, the submission is staged locally.

title.description: PR title describing the documentation change.

filePath.description: Target file path within the repo (e.g., "docs/v6_docs/cookbook/koa-middleware.md").

content.description: Full markdown content for the documentation file.

version.description: FeathersJS version this doc targets (must match filePath prefix).

category.description: Knowledge-base category (optional; auto-detected from content if omitted).

description.description: Optional PR body text explaining the change.

contributorName.description: Optional name for attribution in the PR.

tools.name: remove_documentation
tools.description: Request removal of a documentation file via a GitHub Pull Request for admin review. The document must exist in the knowledge base. If GITHUB_TOKEN is not set, the removal request is staged locally.

filePath.description: Path of the file to remove (e.g., "docs/v6_docs/cookbook/old-guide.md").

version.description: FeathersJS version this doc targets (must match filePath prefix).

reason.description: Explanation for why this document should be removed.

contributorName.description: Optional name for attribution in the PR.

tools.name: update_documentation
tools.description: Update an existing documentation file via a GitHub Pull Request for admin review. The document must already exist in the knowledge base. Content is validated locally (schema, path, sanitization, markdown lint, existence check) then a PR is automatically created. If GITHUB_TOKEN is not set, the update is staged locally. For new documents, use submit_documentation instead.

title.description: PR title describing the documentation update.

filePath.description: Target file path within the repo (must already exist in the knowledge base).

content.description: Full updated markdown content for the documentation file.

version.description: FeathersJS version this doc targets (must match filePath prefix).

category.description: Knowledge-base category (optional; auto-detected from content if omitted).

description.description: Optional PR body text explaining the update.

contributorName.description: Optional name for attribution in the PR.
